review_scope: Independent bounded source and regression-test review; no independent test rerun.
scope_limits: Pure feature helper has no timestamp, source capture or availability proof. Caller must validate real ordered completed bars, actual observation and explicit gap/timeframe semantics.
Changed features are a new version. Compatibility with retained fitted weights is explicitly unproven; this review authorizes no refit, injection, forecast or deployment.
Prefix row counts are not elapsed-clock durations. Full supplied EMA history is intentionally retained; silently truncating history changes values.
Bounds prevent unbounded row/selection sizes but do not constitute a measured memory/runtime guarantee.
verified_properties: Exact-hash original source is parsed and only named constants/functions compile in a private namespace. Original source and module globals remain unchanged.
Scale uses current valid rolling changes or a median of strictly earlier valid scales; it cannot use future suffix values.
The no-observed-crossover fallback uses current prefix row count rather than final dataset length.
Remaining SMA/EMA/differences and cross-period aggregates are prefix-causal by row index; selected-vector and matrix paths share the same original numerical implementation.
Tests cover exact prefix equality across five timeframes and four shapes, source mismatch, input bounds and preserved full-history EMA initialization.
